judul: Naruto: Konoha’s Story The Steam Ninja Scrolls
author: MASASHI KISHIMOTO/SHO HINATA/NATSUO SAI
synopsis: The Naruto spin-off novel is now a manga series! The retired Kakashi and Guy head to a hot springs in the Land of Hot Water with their bodyguard, Sarutobi Mirai! A story connecting two generations through the power of bonds!
